thread:
lee: Customer hit double billing after resume during a truncation+retry. Short repro: stream -> provisional chunk wrote -> truncation happened -> client reconnect -> new node wrote confirmed without seeing provisional.

ana: Are provisionals only local? I thought they went into the ledger right away.

vik: We write a provisional ledger row but stitching is best-effort using node-local cache. If cache evicted between attempts we can create a second provisional.

lee: Proposed quick fix: add a tiny global index keyed by (acct, toolcall_id or prefix_hash) using SETNX in redis with TTL 120s. If SETNX fails, attach to canonical provisional id instead of emitting a new ledger row.

ana: Ops/console needs: a toggle to view provisional rows and a "stitching collisions" counter. Also internal trace endpoint `/internal/billing/trace?canon=...`.

vik: Edge: if canonical never confirms (crash) TTL expiry may allow duplicate later. Tradeoff: choose TTL > typical resume window (e.g., 90s).

billing-bot: note: will open billing ticket to ensure aggregation dedupes by canonical_prov_id.

lee: Action items: vik -> proto redis SETNX, ana -> console mock + support KB, lee -> ledger change to accept `canonical_prov_id`.

ana: I'll also add sampling logs (no prompt text) for any collisions to help QA.

lee: filing issue and will attach mini perf test for p99 impact. :mag:
